shared_elements: circular or disc-shaped motif (rosettes vs concentric rings)
low-relief carving on a flat surface
justification: The only overlap is the very generic presence of human form and round disc-like motifs, which A shows as a dense band of many-petalled rosettes below a narrative frieze and B as isolated concentric rings and arcs on the back of a single massive figure. A depicts a repeated processional scene of clothed men leading horned rams in profile, with fine naturalistic detailing of hair, fleece and drapery, while B is a single schematic frontal/dorsal anthropomorphic block with sparse abstract signs and no narrative or animal content.
